question: Which of the following is the largest pan-India scheme to strengthen health care infrastructure across the country with focus on primary, secondary and tertiary care services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PM-ABHIM.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM-ABHIM:-**

 
 
• It** **stands for** ****Pradhan MantriAyushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission****.**
 
• This scheme is the **largest pan-India scheme** aimed a**t strengthening health care **infrastructure across the country.
 
• It focuses on providing** primary, secondary, and tertiary** care services to the citizens of India.
 
• The scheme aims to improve the availability of** quality health care services**, especially in the** rural and remote areas.**
 
• Additionally, PM-ABHIM also aims to** reduce the financial burden** on the citizens by providing them with affordable health care services.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **LaQshya:-**

 
 
• It​ is a scheme launched by the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** to improve the quality of care in **Labour room **and** Maternity Operation Theatres. **
 
 
 
• **AB-PMJAY:-**
 
 
• It​** **stands for **Ayushman Bharat-Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana.**
 
• It is a scheme aimed at providing **health insurance** to the economically weaker sections of the society. 
 
 
 
• **PM-MI:-**
 
 
• It** **stands for **Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana.**
 
• It is a** maternity benefit programme** that provides financial assistance to **pregnant women and lactating mothers. **
